summary: A record writes the constructor, getters, toString(), equals(), and hashCode() for a class from its component list. Every field in a record is final.
notes: record Grade(String student, int score) declares the fields and the constructor in one line.
The compact constructor Grade { ... } has no parameter list. It runs before the fields are set, so it is the place to validate.
Record getters use the field name with no get prefix: g1.score().
pitfall: Calling g1.getScore() fails to compile with cannot find symbol. A record names the getter score().
